interface.shortDescription: Read-only analysis workflows; SessionStart maintains the current worktree's .codegraph index and required .gitignore.
interface.longDescription: CodeAtlas is one private skill with four routed lanes: UNDERSTAND, TRACE, CHANGE and ASSESS. Analysis workflows are read-only. SessionStart may initialize or sync only the exact current worktree's .codegraph index and any required .gitignore, with bounded no-download/no-daemon/no-watcher behavior; failures become same-session Agent takeover instructions. It negotiates visible MCP tools at runtime and reports ready, cli-only, needs-agent or unavailable evidence honestly.
defaultPrompt: Use CodeAtlas to understand this repository area.
Use CodeAtlas to trace this request or symbol.
Use CodeAtlas to assess maintainability before the next change.
